sideB.text:
ANTANANARIVO

Black city art with a white upgrade panel and a green ring. No other text.

rules: Black Infection card for Antananarivo. Same printed face as card 17, including the code P7-17b.
The white center panel is the infection-card upgrade slot.
notes: The corner code is P7-17b, the same code as card 17. It is not printed P7-18b.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
